name: Northside Barbers
tagline: Proper cuts, no fuss. Walk in or book ahead.
description: Friendly neighbourhood barbers in Headingley. Skin fades, classic cuts, beard trims and hot towel shaves, with kids and seniors welcome.

services.title: Services & prices
services.intro: Straightforward prices, no surprises. Every cut finishes with a hot towel and a styling product of your choice.

items.name: Skin fade
items.description: Taken down to the skin, blended by hand.

items.name: Restyle
items.description: Long to short, or a whole new look.

items.name: Beard trim & shape
items.description: Shaped with clippers, lined with a razor.

items.name: Hot towel shave
items.description: Pre-shave oil, two hot towels, straight razor.

items.name: Cut & beard
items.description: Any cut plus a full beard trim.

categories.name: Kids & seniors
categories.description: Kids under 12. Seniors 65+, Monday to Thursday.

services.note: Card and cash welcome. Very long or thick hair may cost a little more; we'll always tell you before we start.

walkIns.title: Walk-ins welcome
walkIns.description: No appointment needed. Grab a seat and we'll get you in the chair. Prefer a set time? Book ahead.

reviews.title: What people say
reviews.intro: Real talk from the chair. Most of our regulars started as walk-ins.

items.author: Danny M.
items.text: Best fade I've had in Leeds. Jay takes his time and actually listens. Walked in on a Tuesday and was in the chair in ten minutes.

items.author: Chris O.
items.text: Treated myself to Sam's hot towel shave before a wedding. Closest shave of my life and properly relaxing.

items.author: Priya K.
items.text: Brought my son for his first proper haircut. Lewis was brilliant with him, really patient. He's asking when he can go back.

items.author: Tom H.
items.text: Great cut and beard tidy. It was busy on a Saturday morning so expect a wait, or book ahead like I should have.

items.author: Marcus D.
items.text: Went from long hair to a short textured crop. Lewis talked me through it and nailed it. Fair price too.

items.author: Gary W.
items.text: Been coming every three weeks since they opened. Friendly lads, good chat, never a bad cut.

faqs.title: Questions
faqs.intro: Anything else? Give us a ring or pop in.

items.question: Do I need to book?
items.answer: No. Walk-ins are welcome all day and we'll get you in as soon as a chair's free. If you'd rather not wait, especially on Saturday mornings, book online and your slot's held.

items.question: How long is the wait for a walk-in?
items.answer: Usually around 15 minutes. Saturday mornings and Thursday and Friday evenings are busiest, when it can be 30 to 40 minutes. The strip at the top of the page shows the typical wait right now.

items.question: Can I book with a specific barber?
items.answer: Yes. Choose your barber when you book online, or ask for them when you walk in and we'll let you know how long they'll be.

items.question: Do you cut kids' hair?
items.answer: Absolutely. Kids under 12 are £15, and we're happy to take things slowly for a first cut. Weekday afternoons are the quietest time to bring little ones.

items.question: Can I pay by card?
items.answer: Yes, we take card, contactless and cash.

items.question: Is there parking nearby?
items.answer: There's on-street parking on the side roads off Otley Road and a pay-and-display car park two minutes' walk away. We're also on the main bus routes into town.

policies.title: House rules
policies.intro: A few things that keep the chairs moving and fair for everyone.

items.title: Cancellations
items.body: Can't make it? Cancel or move your booking at least 4 hours before, so someone else can have the slot.

items.title: Running late
items.body: We'll hold your slot for 10 minutes. After that we may need to shorten your service or move you to the next free chair.

items.title: No-shows
items.body: Two missed bookings without notice and we'll ask for a deposit next time you book online.

items.title: Kids
items.body: Under-16s need a parent or guardian with them for the whole cut.

items.title: Prices
items.body: Prices are a guide. Very long or thick hair may cost a little more; we'll always tell you before we start.

items.title: Feeling unwell?
items.body: Please rebook if you're poorly. There's no charge for moving a booking for illness.

products.title: Take it home
products.intro: The products we use in the chair, so you can get the same finish at home. Ask your barber what suits your hair.

items.name: Matte Clay
items.description: Strong hold, no shine. Our most-used finish for textured crops.

items.name: Sea Salt Spray
items.description: Adds grip and volume before blow-drying. Great for fine hair.

items.name: Water-based Pomade
items.description: Medium hold with a clean shine that washes straight out.

items.name: Beard Oil
items.description: Softens the beard and stops the itch. A few drops a day.

products.note: In store only. Card, contactless or cash.

loyalty.title: Loyalty card
loyalty.description: Get a stamp every time you're in the chair. Fill the card and your next cut is on us.
loyalty.terms: One stamp per visit for any cut over £14. Pick up a card at the counter.

visit.title: Find us
visit.intro: On Otley Road, five minutes from the middle of Headingley.

notes.title: By bus
notes.body: Most buses along Otley Road stop within a two-minute walk of the shop.

notes.title: Parking
notes.body: On-street parking on the side roads, plus a pay-and-display car park two minutes away.

notes.title: Access
notes.body: Step-free entrance and one chair that lowers fully. Let us know if you need anything else.

notes.title: Walk-ins
notes.body: Last walk-in is 30 minutes before closing, so we can give everyone a proper cut.
